summary: Withhold optimistic folder batches when server-resolved ancestry cannot be reconstructed

schema.detail: No wire or journal format change.

compatibility.detail: An observed live folder whose raw parent differs from its shown parent signals server cycle cuts, ancestor lifts or orphan resolution. Every folder batch retains observed rows in that case. Membership inputs expose effective buckets, not retained raw positions: when any root-visible member exists, a create whose ID has no visible parent reference also withholds optimism, because that member might move into the newly revealed bucket. Authoritative readback supplies the resulting rows. No daemon resolver is duplicated; membership-only overlays remain available.

recovery.detail: No rollback or journal change; authoritative observed projection replaces withheld folder optimism.
